# SAPFX: SAP test automation for Robot Framework

Agent contract v1: [.claude/agent-contract.md](.claude/agent-contract.md).
Five roles include read-only sap-verifier (Claude Code /sap-verify; Copilot
.github/agents/sap-verifier.agent.md, generated). Explicit permissions,
bounded healer verdicts, hashed handoffs and conservative recovery milestones.
PreToolUse asks for non-read calls; qualify host loading before relying on it.
Budgets/journaling remain agent-operated; offline tests do not prove LLM quality.
Never add skips or replace baselines to turn an unverified heal green.

> Open-source SAP test-automation ecosystem for Robot Framework, covering both
> SAP paradigms end to end: SapEccLibrary (SAP GUI desktop client, ECC and
> S/4HANA backend, via the SAP GUI Scripting COM API), SapFioriLibrary
> (Fiori / SAPUI5 / UI5 Web Components on the web, alongside the Browser
> library / Playwright), SapApiLibrary (OData v2/v4 full CRUD + $batch +
> metadata discovery + Gateway preflight + test-data factory + optional
> RFC/BAPI), shared pure engines (locator healing, screen perception, visual
> hashing, semantic labels, business vocabulary), desktop and web recorders,
> and AI test agents (plan → generate → heal) composed over the rf-mcp MCP
> server.

Non-negotiable conventions: tests contain no raw SAP ids or CSS/XPath
(business keywords live in `resources/`); never `time.sleep`, always
condition-based waits (`Wait Until Busy Done` on ECC, `Wait For Ui5 Idle`
after an action that triggers OData on Fiori: a rendered view is not yet
its data); assertions are locale-independent (message *types*, never
localized texts, on the web too through
`Ui5 Should Have No Messages Of Type`); every keyword has an off-SAP unit test (fake COM /
fake Browser); ambiguity is always surfaced with candidates, never resolved
by silent first match; capabilities live in the LIBRARIES, never as inline
JS or `Evaluate __import__` in the Robot layer (`resources/` carries the
business vocabulary only, enforced by `scripts/check_conventions.py` with an
exact-count allowlist), and that vocabulary ships as an EXAMPLE measured on
this repo's lab targets, to be verified and customized per target and per
business domain, `src/` being what makes truth everywhere; and no code file
grows past 500 lines, split along a
seam the codebase already uses (one mixin per capability, pure logic in
`sapfx_common`) rather than at the line count, enforced by
`scripts/check_file_length.py`. Distribution: `pip install robotframework-sapfx`
(PyPI: the four libraries only), the self-contained Windows deployment pack
(GitHub Releases, the ONLY full-install channel: libraries + recorders +
rf-mcp plugins + business resources + test agents; the installer still pulls
pinned dependencies from PyPI or an internal mirror), and the public source repo
<https://github.com/CyrilM29/robotframework-sapfx>.

## Docs

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): the two paradigms unified above the
  technical layer, in Robot Framework business keywords
- [Fiori architecture](docs/fiori-architecture.md): the injected `__SAPFX`
  bundle and its five engines: role (UI5 registry), xpath (control
  hierarchy), sid (SAP GUI for HTML / WebGUI), wc (UI5 Web Components pages
  without a UI5 runtime, light DOM and open shadow roots), dom (generic
  CSS/text + computed ARIA role +
  accessible name `name=`: user-intent locators for the non-SAP regions of
  hybrid pages; `name=` also on the wc engine via the UI5 Web Components
  `accessible-name` convention), plus the hybrid-page probe
  `Get Page Composition`, the
  nested-iframe frame stack (`Push/Pop Ui5 Frame`) and the aggregated
  diagnostics keyword `Get Fiori Diagnostics` (composition + UI5 tree +
  console/page errors + ARIA snapshot, actionable `issues` summary)
- [Test agents](docs/test-agents.md): sap-planner / sap-generator /
  sap-healer: live exploration through rf-mcp, plans in `specs/` as the
  source of truth, every generated step verified live before being written;
  sap-istqb turns planner specs and recorder outputs into ISTQB test plans +
  test cases under `specs/istqb/` (human-readable, replayable by an AI with
  any framework via normalized replay blocks);
  `/sap-maintain` chains sentinel → healing telemetry → healer into one
  report, `/sap-eval-healer` evaluates the healer blind on a simulated drift
  (`scripts/agent_eval_harness.py`)
- [MCP integration](docs/mcp-integration.md): plugins composed over rf-mcp
  (keyword routing, screen perception state providers (smart diffs on
  changed screens, live application state with modal detection, stale-code
  warning, one contract across the three channels: connected/state_error,
  a section that failed vs one that has no meaning here), selector guidance),
  plus the `sapfx-mcp` overlay launcher (rf-mcp unchanged +
  `sapfx_state`/`sapfx_screenshot`/`sapfx_reload` tools, a startup
  compatibility guard and respect for the declared capabilities, not a fork)
- [Hardening the test environment](docs/hardening-test-environment.md):
  security checklist (RZ11 server posture, client patch level and input
  history, credentials, MV3/CDP surface, MCP containment) mapped to the
  preflight keywords that verify it
- [Testing without SAP](docs/testing-without-sap.md): ABAP Platform Trial in
  Docker for ECC; the Fiori side needs no SAP at all
- [SAP test data](docs/sap-test-data.md): verified data models and public
  test targets, UI5 compatibility matrix
- [Migrating from robotframework-sapguilibrary](docs/migrating-from-sapguilibrary.md):
  drop-in upgrade path from the upstream library
- [Migrating from CBTA](docs/migrating-from-cbta.md): concept mapping and
  migration path before Solution Manager maintenance ends (2027-12-31)

All docs are bilingual: each `*.md` has a French `*.fr.md` twin.

## Key entry points

- `resources/` (**examples to customize, never a universal SAP truth**, see
  `resources/README.md`): the business-readable keyword layer a test calls,
  measured live on this repo's lab targets. Much of it travels (standard
  screens and services, the mirrored naming), none of it is authoritative:
  verify on your target and adapt to your business domain. What IS universal
  is `src/`, the libraries, which carry the capabilities.
  `resources/ecc_keywords.resource`, `resources/fiori_keywords.resource`,
  `resources/api_keywords.resource` and `resources/rfc_keywords.resource` are
  one mirrored vocabulary across the four channels (ECC, Fiori, API and RFC;
  OData service paths, function-module, BAPI and table names live there under
  business names, never in a suite), plus
  `resources/cross_channel_keywords.resource` which carries the entity set to
  table mapping of the cross-channel campaign
- `resources/page_objects/`: one `.resource` per screen or application
  (locator variables + business keywords, the layer sap-healer repairs);
  includes `abap_flp.resource`, a launchpad page object shared by two UI5
  releases (1.71 and 1.120) where every divergence is a variable or a named
  strategy, never a version `IF`
- `tests/robot/ui/fiori/`: live launchpad campaigns, all read-only by default:
  a SAP Build Work Zone cFLP behind a real IAS tenant (iframe scope,
  catalogue by service) and the ABAP FLP explored on two releases
  (`exploration_flp_abap_a4h.robot` 19/19, `exploration_flp_abap_2023.robot`
  21/21, the second existing to break single-release assumptions and the
  shared page object replayed on both to prove it), plus
  `navigation_interaction_demokit.robot` (12/12), the one campaign that needs
  no credentials and no system to provision: hash routing, deep links, API
  tree, doc tables, popover cascades, theme and sample iframe on the public
  OpenUI5 Demo Kit, browser visible by default
- `tests/robot/cross/croisement_ddic_odata.robot`: the cross-channel acceptance
  campaign (spec `specs/croisement-ddic-odata-ecc-s4hana.md`), read-only and
  reusable on ECC and S/4HANA: which tables and entity sets a target really
  exposes, and whether the screen and the API agree on existence, volume and
  field contract
- `tests/robot/cross/simulation_ecriture_lecture.robot`: its write counterpart
  (spec `specs/simulation-ecriture-lecture-cross-canal.md`), a reversible row
  written through the screen and observed through the API, then deleted and its
  disappearance asserted on the entity. Opt-in: it skips in Suite Setup without
  opening a channel unless the opt-in variable is passed
- `src/SapEccLibrary/`: vendored upstream base + mixins (connection, waits,
  grids and grid actions (double-click, context menu by function code, sort),
  trees (SAP menu, IMG, SE80: read/expand/select by key, text or path), combo
  boxes by technical key plus the user's date/decimal formats (`Input Date`,
  `Input Number`), menu bar by path, modal windows, system identity read on
  screen (`Get System Identity`: SAP_BASIS release and kernel from System >
  Status, entry RESOLVED as second-to-last of the second-to-last menu on two
  releases), status message identity (`MO/E/402`, `Status Message Should Be`),
  tab strips by technical key, application toolbar inventory (icon names as
  locale-safe anchors), SE16 output modes (ALV grid or standard list,
  the classic list read as labels), perception (shell subtypes
  shown, unreadable session fails naming the cause), diagnostics/preflights,
  healing, semantic labels (checkboxes and radios by their own text, F4
  calendar), embedded browser, pointer fallback, multi-session registry: named
  session aliases with an STA rail that re-attaches per thread and isolated
  teardown)
- `src/SapFioriLibrary/`: UI5 resolution engines, launchpad intent
  navigation, identity-provider login flows, visual assertions
- `src/sapfx_common/`: shared pure logic (polling, healing scores,
  perception diff, visual hash, semantic geometry, business vocabulary,
  system identity, generic deterministic artifacts (`artifacts`: declared
  hash scope, hash recomputed on read, importable as a Robot library),
  IDP presets), typed and unit-tested without SAP or a browser
- `tests/robot/`: smoke suites runnable against public targets (OpenUI5 Demo
  Kit, local fixtures, UI5 legacy/legacy-free/2.x CDN builds) or a live A4H
- `CLAUDE.md`: the canonical, detailed contributor guide (layout table,
  conventions, field notes from live SAP systems)
